name: Cordathin
manufacturer: Unknown — suspected Nightshade Pharmatech black-lab synthesis
description: Cordathin is a lipid-soluble compound that binds to cardiac ion channels and progressively dysregulates calcium flux over a period of four to seven months, producing symptoms indistinguishable from idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy. Standard autopsies and BCI health monitors interpret Cordathin-induced degradation as natural cardiac disease, logging it as progressive heart failure with no flagged anomalies. A single dermal exposure is sufficient for a lethal dose.
effects: Fatal within 4-7 months at standard dosing
Leaves no toxicological signature in standard panels
side_effects: Victim experiences genuine fatigue, edema, and dyspnea consistent with heart failure — no unusual symptoms to raise suspicion
Antidote window closes after 72 hours of exposure
Accidental contact during application is fatal to the handler without immediate chelation
duration: 4-7 months to lethality; compound is metabolized and undetectable after 3 weeks
street_price: Φ18,000–Φ45,000 per dose depending on provenance verification
cultural_context: Cordathin is the preferred instrument of corporate succession wars — used to remove executives, board members, and political rivals who cannot be touched openly. Its six-month window allows the poisoner to be nowhere near the city when the target dies. In Spire circles it is spoken of in euphemism: someone who has been 'given their notice' or 'put on the calendar.' Street-level fixers rarely handle it — the margins are too thin and the clientele too dangerous. Most doses are brokered through intermediaries with no names.
story_hooks: A Tier 4 corporate doctor notices a statistical anomaly — three executives at the same firm have died of 'heart failure' in eighteen months, all under sixty, all in perfect BCI-monitored health six months prior. She starts asking questions and something starts asking questions back.
A fixer is hired to retrieve an antidote for a client who has already been dosed — but the only supplier of the chelation compound is the same person who ordered the poisoning.
A street chemist on the Shelf claims she reverse-engineered Cordathin from a sample and can produce a detection assay — making her the most dangerous woman in GLMZ to certain people in the Spire.
